> **Pull requests are generally not accepted on this project.**
>
> This package is published primarily as a showcase of the author's own work, so
> the codebase is deliberately kept single-authored. This applies to small fixes
> and typo corrections too.
>
> - Found a bug, or something wrong in the docs? Please open an **issue** instead.
> - Need a change for your own use? Please **fork** it — the MIT license allows that.
>
> If you open a pull request anyway, it will most likely be closed without being
> merged. That is the policy, not a judgement of your work. Thank you for
> understanding.
